title: Optimize batched_moe_align_block_size_kernel with cooperative writes
body_opening:
Summary:
Upstream the optimization from D93429906 (avocado_v1) to trunk.

The original implementation had each thread serially write all tokens for its batch, creating a bottleneck when individual batches have many tokens. This replaces the serial per-thread writes with cooperative all-thread writes using shared memory: per-batch results (cumsum, token counts) are stored to shared memory after the prefix sum, then all 1024 threads participate in strided loops to write sorted_ids and block_ids for every batch. This distributes the memory write work evenly across the entire thread block.

title: fix(flashmla): bypass aten::new_empty int32 overflow during massive dummy runs
body_opening:
Fixes #57878.

**Root Cause**: 
During the engine initialization dummy run with `--enforce-eager` on SM90, a massive dummy shape (e.g., 16384 tokens) causes the FlashMLA C++ backend's internal shape math to overflow PyTorch's 32-bit `aten::new_empty` integer limit, triggering an immediate crash.

**Fix**:
Truncate the query tensor to a safe element boundary before calling the C++ kernel during the dummy run. After the kernel executes, we pad the output tensor back to its full massive size (e.g., 2.14GB) using Python's `new_zeros` (which safely uses 64-bit sizes). This correctly reserves the memory for the profiler without crashing the C++ dispatcher.

title: [Bugfix][Tokenizer] Avoid retaining pool overflow copies
body_opening:
## Purpose

`maybe_make_thread_pool` preallocates tokenizer copies, but its unbounded queue also retained every temporary copy created when the pool was exhausted. A single concurrency burst could therefore permanently grow the idle pool to its historical peak; real fast-tokenizer copies can retain substantial native memory.

This change keeps the configured copies in the pool and treats extra concurrent borrows as temporary: they remain non-blocking, but are released when the call finishes. It also narrows the `queue.Empty` handler to acquisition, so a wrapped tokenizer method that raises `queue.Empty` is propagated instead of being mistaken for a pool miss.
